name: Hahnbee Lee
bio: Hahnbee Lee is the co-founder of Mintlify, which she launched with Han Wang to reimagine documentation for the AI era. Under her leadership, Mintlify has raised over $67M in funding, scaled to serve 300 million users across more than 20,000 companies, and earned a spot on Forbes' 2026 30 Under 30 list for AI.

sessions.title: Developer Docs as Knowledge Infrastructure for Fintech
